title: Calendrier 'Pataphysique — fêtes et saints
coverage: 377 entries = 13 months × 29 days (incl. the 29th of each month); names from jchr.be, ranks from icalendrier.fr; 2 days disagree between the two reproductions (stored as variant_icalendrier).

sources.name: fr.wikipedia, Calendrier pataphysique (spot-check examples, rank counts)

notes: Not the Collège's official edition (calenpat.pdf, not retrievable); editions differ. jchr.be marks retained vulgar-calendar saints with °. Rank counts from icalendrier (SPp 3, SPs 8, SS 22, ST 40, V 37) differ slightly from fr.wikipedia's (2, 8, 22, 41, 39).
